**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Auto-renewal:** none exists. Maintenance is a "renewable one-year term" (p0065), so continuation beyond 12 months requires mutual agreement and our election to pay renewal fees — the preferred position. There is no "automatically renew" language and therefore no non-renewal notice window to compute, and no multi-year renewal risk (walk-away territory avoided).
- **Exit:** the licence is perpetual while fees are paid (p0117) and we may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice (p0118), so renewals are easy for us to exit.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the Agreement/Fee Schedule contains no renewal price-uplift cap (preferred: lesser of CPI and 3%). Because it also gives Garman no unilateral escalation right, this is a missing sub-element only — worth adding if the Fee Schedule is reopened.
